name: BYTE PHANTOM
realCapabilities: Windows SYSTEM INTELLIGENCE: read-only local host, CPU, memory, disk, and IPv4 interface inventory
NETWORK RADAR on Windows and Android using each device's own native network APIs
Active discovery of directly connected private IPv4 subnets from /22 through /30, capped at 1,022 host addresses per scan
One ICMP echo request per target host during active sweeps, enriched with ARP/neighbor-table MAC addresses where available
Four-second neighbour refresh and scheduled active rediscovery every 30 seconds
Live event history for newly detected devices, IP changes, reappearance, and nodes no longer visible in recent snapshots
Persistent Network Radar journal stored locally on this app installation: first/last-seen timestamps, device visibility, and network-change events

android.nativeBridge: Capacitor 6 local Java plugin, registered in MainActivity
android.scanImplementation: /system/bin/ping with one ICMP echo request per host; /proc/net/arp and ip neigh for MAC/interface enrichment

security: Network discovery is limited to directly connected private IPv4 subnets. No port scanning, credential tests, exploitation, internet-wide scans, privilege escalation, or network/system configuration changes. This is not a guaranteed complete router-client inventory; client isolation, sleeping hosts, filtered ICMP, separate VLANs/subnets, OEM restrictions, and emulator NAT can limit visibility. Network Radar device identifiers and timestamps are retained only in this installation's local app storage for up to 30 days; report contents are copied only when the user explicitly requests it.

networkRadarJournal.storage: Versioned localStorage on this device; no remote sync or upload
networkRadarJournal.reportDelivery: Copied to the local clipboard only after an explicit user action
